title: Electrical BIM Coordinater
description:
We're Hiring – BIM Coordinator (Electrical)

Locations: Nagpur | Indore | Noida  
Experience: 8–12 Years  
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

About the Role

Lead Electrical BIM coordination across international projects while ensuring quality deliverables and multidisciplinary collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead end-to-end Electrical BIM coordination across all project phases.

· Develop and review Revit MEP models in compliance with BEP, LOD, QA/QC, and client standards.

· Develop, review, and maintain Revit Fabrication models while ensuring proper use and maintenance of fabrication databases in accordance with project and industry standards.

· Perform clash detection and multidisciplinary coordination using Navisworks and Revizto.

· Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to resolve technical issues.

· Prepare and review shop drawings, construction documentation, BOQs, and quantity take-offs.

· Participate in BIM coordination meetings and ensure timely closure of coordination issues.

· Maintain BIM standards, templates, and project documentation.

· Mentor BIM Engineers and support project delivery.

· Ensure model quality, compliance, and timely submission of deliverables.

· Lead the development, review, and continual refinement of the BIM Execution Plan (BEP) across all project stages.

· Own the clash detection and coordination strategy, chairing discipline coordination meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

· Conduct model audits and QA/QC checks against project LOD and modelling standards, and drive corrective action where needed.

· Oversee Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows, including model publishing, version control, and issue resolution tracking.

· Coordinate with structural, architectural, and other disciplines to pre-empt and resolve complex interdisciplinary clashes.

· Review and respond to RFIs and technical queries, escalating unresolved design or coordination issues as needed.

· Supervise and allocate work to BIM Engineers and Modelers, reviewing output for accuracy, compliance, and quality.

· Act as the primary point of contact for client BIM Managers, consultants, and project leadership on all BIM matters.

· Support bid/proposal stage BIM scoping, resourcing, and fee estimation for new projects.

· Oversee digital handover deliverables (COBie/AIM) and ensure compliance with client asset information requirements.

· Provide final QA/QC sign-off and approval prior to submission of deliverables to clients.

· Develop, maintain, and roll out Dynamo scripts and other automation tools (e.g. pyRevit, Autodesk Forge/APS) to streamline modelling, documentation, and coordination workflows across the team, minimizing manual effort.

What We're Looking For

· B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering.

· Experience in Electrical BIM Modelling and Coordination.

· Proficiency in Autodesk Revit MEP, Autodesk Revit Fabrication, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and ACC/BIM 360.

· Strong understanding of BEP, CDE, LOD, ISO 19650, and QA/QC processes.

· Experience delivering international projects.

· Strong working knowledge of Dynamo and/or Python scripting, with proven ability to build automation tools that improve team-wide BIM workflow efficiency.

Technical Expertise

· Power distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, and cable containment/routing.

· Lighting design coordination, including lighting controls and emergency lighting systems.

· Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems: CCTV, access control, public address, and structured cabling/data networks.

· Fire alarm and detection systems, including device layout and cable routing coordination.

· Earthing, bonding, and lightning protection systems.

· Standby and backup power systems (DG sets, UPS) and integration with main distribution.

· Codes and standards: NEC, IEC, BS 7671, NFPA 70/72, IEEE guidelines.

· Advanced coordination of complex electrical routing and panel/riser layouts in high-density MEP zones.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Maintenance Engineer – High Voltage Substations)

As a Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliable operation and maintenance of High Voltage substations across customer sites. You will be responsible for maintaining 220kV and medium voltage substations, supporting preventive and corrective maintenance activities, troubleshooting equipment issues, and ensuring adherence to safety and operational standards.

In this role, you will work closely with customers, vendors, and site teams to deliver high-quality service and operational excellence. You will contribute to the performance and reliability of key power transmission assets while supporting continuous improvement initiatives and maintaining strong customer relationships. We are looking for a technically sound professional with hands-on experience in High Voltage substations, strong troubleshooting capabilities, and a customer-focused approach.

How You'll Make an Impact

* Perform operation and maintenance activities for 220kV and Medium Voltage substations, ensuring equipment reliability and maximum availability.

* Execute preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities for substation equipment and associated systems.

* Conduct testing and commissioning support for primary electrical equipment in High Voltage AC switchyards and analyze test results for effective fault diagnosis.

* Carry out offline and online condition monitoring of switchyard equipment and support relay protection systems, numerical relays, and SCADA-based monitoring solutions.

* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to substations, protection systems, motors, drives, transformers, and switchyard equipment to minimize downtime.

* Ensure compliance with Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards, Siemens Energy policies, and customer-specific safety requirements.

* Provide technical training and knowledge sharing to site personnel on power transmission products, including Extra High Voltage transformers, AIS/GIS equipment, isolators, lightning arresters, and earthing systems.

* Coordinate effectively with customers, contractors, and onsite vendors to ensure smooth site execution and service delivery.

* Support site management activities, including resource planning, work scheduling, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, operational excellence, safety, and customer satisfaction.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 3-4 years of relevant experience, or Diploma in Electrical Engineering with 6+ years of relevant experience.

* Hands-on experience in operation and maintenance of High Voltage substations, preferably in 220kV, 400kV, or 765kV networks.

* Strong technical knowledge of High Voltage primary equipment, protection systems, switchyards, and substation maintenance practices.

* Experience in testing, diagnostics, condition monitoring, and troubleshooting of electrical equipment in transmission substations.

* Familiarity with numerical relays, protection schemes, SCADA systems, and substation automation.

* Good understanding of HT/LT motors, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), compressors, chillers, and utility plant equipment will be an added advantage.

* Sound knowledge of Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) practices and safe working procedures in High Voltage installations.

* Strong customer-facing skills with the confidence and technical capability to interact directly with customers and resolve site-related issues.

* Proven ability to lead and coordinate site teams, contractors, and vendor personnel to achieve project and service objectives.

* Good communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills with a customer-centric mindset.

* Willingness to travel and work at customer sites as per business requirements.

About Siemens Energy India

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customer installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping countries navigate their energy transition and achieve their net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support customers along the entire energy value chain in their energy transition journey. Our portfolio includes low to zero-emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and industrial decarbonization solutions.

Location & Travel

This role is based at customer project sites in Nagpur and other locations across West India. You will also have the opportunity to visit other project sites across India as per business requirements. In return, you will work on critical power infrastructure projects that help shape the future of energy transmission and distribution.

Diversity & Inclusion

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character regardless of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Benefits

* Comprehensive Medical Insurance coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

* Company-sponsored family floater health insurance as per policy.

* Meal Card option as a tax-saving benefit.

* Flexi Pay options that allow employees to optimize salary components and enhance take-home pay.

* Opportunities for learning, growth, and exposure to large-scale energy infrastructure projects across India.
